units.en: For the pre-1.17 doctrine system, see a previous version of this page.

⟦0⟧ allows a nation to specialize the way its army conducts ⟦1⟧. Land doctrines are split into Grand Doctrines and Subdoctrines. They can be reviewed and unlocked from the ⟦2⟧ using ⟦3⟧. There are four mutually exclusive grand doctrines which have unique milestones for each track when a subdoctrine is mastered.

Grand Doctrines represent the overall doctrine of an army. They provide bonuses and enable a ⟦0⟧ when unlocked, as well as unique milestones for each track once mastered. Only one Grand Doctrine can be enabled at a time. Switching Grand Doctrine resets all Mastery in the land folder.

Mobile Warfare Divisions speed: +10% Planning Speed: +20% Enables tactic: Unexpected Thrust Hit them where they don't expect - mobile warfare doctrine seeks to break the trench deadlock of the First World War via aggressive maneuvers to pre-empt and disrupt the enemy.

Superior Firepower Enables tactic: Overwhelming Fire Line Artillery: Soft Attack: +10% Support Companies: Soft Attack: +5% Send shells, not men - Superior Firepower emphasizes employing crushing masses of fire to pave the way for maneuver units to advance and capture territory.

Grand Battleplan Max planning: +10% Daily Command Power Gain: +0.25 Enables tactic: Well-Planned Attack With sufficient preparation, no obstacle is insurmountable - Grand Battleplan is characterized by patient, meticulous preparation of all arms, in both attack and defense.

Mass Assault Non-Combat Out of Supply Penalties: -10% Supply Grace: +48 Hours Enables tactic: Relentless Assault Our willingness to sacrifice guarantees our victory - Mass Assault focuses on concentrating numerical superiority to force a breakthrough at the chosen time and place.

Tracks are split into four categories: Infantry, Artillery & Combat Support, Armor, and Operations. Each has a set of subdoctrines shared among each grand doctrine. Mastery is used to unlock milestones within the subdoctrine, granting further bonuses. Each track gains Mastery when certain units engage in action, or at a reduced rate (10%) while training. If a subdoctrine is not selected, up to 200 Mastery is held in reserve (banked at a rate of 25% of further gain).
When a track has been mastered, it unlocks the grand doctrine milestone for the track. One of the milestones increases ⟦0⟧ and each milestone (excluding ⟦1⟧ Operations) enables a ⟦2⟧.

Subdoctrines allow an army to specialize in different types of combat. Subdoctrines provide some bonuses when picked, and additional bonuses are unlocked when enough Mastery is accumulated in each Doctrine Track. Only one Subdoctrine can be enabled from each Doctrine Track at a time. Grand Doctrines do not affect which Subdoctrines are available. Each milestone within a subdoctrine requires 100 Mastery (cumulative), unless otherwise noted.
